get_abuse_notice:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_abuse_notice(p_user_id uuid, p_device text, p_ip text, p_country text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select case when r is not null then jsonb_build_object('mode',r->>'mode','reason',r->>'reason','expiresAt',r->>'expires_at') when exists(select 1 from abuse_identity_reviews ar join users u on u.auth_user_id=ar.auth_user_id where u.id=p_user_id and ar.verified_at is null and exists(select 1 from auth.users au where au.id=ar.auth_user_id and au.email_confirmed_at is null and au.phone_confirmed_at is null)) then jsonb_build_object('mode','review') else '{}'::jsonb end from (select abuse_matching_restriction(p_user_id,p_device,p_ip,p_country) r) result),'{}');
$function$
